en.description: Turn one product photo into a vertical product video that speaks. This AI product video generator and product video maker builds ecommerce product videos, product ads, and commerce short videos from a single photo — composing a 9:16 opening frame, writing a short script from what the photo shows and the details you supply, voicing it with a selected narrator, and directing one finished clip ready to post. Use it for product launches, listing videos, shoppable social posts, storefront promos, and turning a phone snap of merchandise into a video that sells, with no shoot, no crew, and no editing.
en.summary: Turn one product photo into a vertical product video with spoken narration, ready to post.
